services.desc: Experience a private 4 hour inshore fishing charter along the South Shore of Massachusetts with Blueline Fishing Charters. Guided by Captain Horte, this trip targets Striped Bass, Bluefish, in productive areas including Hingham Bay, Hull, Weymouth, Quincy and Boston Harbor. The charter includes all fishing gear, bait, and necessary licenses, and is suited for all skill levels. With flexible departure times.
